$comment: Known divergences from the canonical implementation (HMD-0020 §10). Each entry names a conformance case this implementation is expected to fail, and why. A case listed here that PASSES fails the build: an expected failure that starts succeeding and is not removed is how a ledger rots into a lie.

rendering.reason: Raw HTML in a card is escaped rather than passed through. Deliberate: a webview rendering workspace HTML is a script-injection surface reachable from any cloned repository.
Collapsible `???` callouts have no markdown-it equivalent; they render as plain markdown.
`!!! note` callouts render as plain paragraphs; no markdown-it plugin is bundled yet.
Inline and display math render as literal text; KaTeX is not bundled yet.
A `d2` fence renders as a code block. D2 shells out to a binary the extension does not ship.
`~x~` subscript is unsupported; markdown-it's builtin only covers `~~strikethrough~~`.

markdown-it recognises setext headings (`Title` over `=====`); the canonical scanner finds ATX headings only, so a setext heading has no slug on the Python side and is not addressable by `[[Page#Section]]`.
Column numbers count UTF-16 code units here and code points in Python, so a diagnostic after an emoji on the same line can differ by one per astral character.
